# Professional Description

Esquire Deposition Solutions is a nationally recognized court reporting and litigation support firm serving Long Beach, CA, with extensive expertise across diverse practice areas including construction defect, commercial, employment, intellectual property, and product liability litigation. The firm distinguishes itself through advanced technology integration, experienced court reporters, and comprehensive amenities including two conference rooms, complimentary high-speed internet, visitor parking, and teleconferencing capabilities. With a convenient downtown location and services available across nearly every state, Esquire delivers a streamlined deposition experience backed by exceptional customer service.
